liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue down to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

Debt due within one year declined by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, which cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2024}} cover, so the near-term maturities do not depend on new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, only {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}} of total debt, as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2024}} to {{net_capex@FY2024}}.
The group issued a bond in May 2024, and S&P rates it {{rating_sp@FY2024}} with a stable outlook.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow after lease payments dropped by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, leaving FCF after leases to debt at {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}, down {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}}.

Liquidity: cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and cash liquidity to revenue declined by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, in line with the peer median.

Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2024}}, so capital spending absorbs a larger share of cash flow.
Earnings quality: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, the weakest of the airport group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2024}}).
